description: A bearded man in scale armour and a red cloak stands at the prow of a dark wooden galley, holding a gold icon of a Madonna and child. Oarsmen and spearmen crowd the boat behind him, with lanterns glowing. Ahead, a fleet of sailing ships moves across rough grey water toward a walled fortress with tall towers, where fires burn on the battlements under a stormy sky. A small mark sits in the bottom-right corner.
